snippet.title: Galactic Vault - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
How far can you push your weapon to its limits?

Galactic Vault is a fast-paced FPS roguelite where you infiltrate high-security vaults, recover lost technology, and build devastating weapon combinations.

Adapt your playstyle, experiment with upgrades, and survive increasingly dangerous challenges.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585460/Galactic_Vault/

🚀 About the Game

🔫 Weapon Customization
• Transform weapons with powerful attachments
• Turn simple guns into unique hybrid builds

⚙️ Endless Combinations
• Discover upgrades during each run
• Create insane synergies and effects

💥 High-Speed Gameplay
• Fast movement with jumping, sliding, and dashing
• Designed for fluid and stylish combat

🤖 Dangerous Enemies
• Face robots, drones, and enhanced enemies
• Each encounter tests your build and reflexes

👑 Boss Encounters
• Challenge powerful bosses in each vault
• Push your build to its true limits

🛠️ Custom Vaults
• Create and share your own vault challenges
• Explore content made by other players
